name: Titanium.UI.iOS.PreviewAction
summary:
A PreviewAction provides options to configure actions used by the iOS 9 3D-Touch "Peek and Pop"
feature.
description:
The PreviewAction is created by the [Titanium.UI.iOS.createPreviewAction](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#createPreviewAction) method. Set the
`title` property when creating a PreviewAction object.

Use this class to configure preview actions used in the [Titanium.UI.iOS.PreviewContext](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.PreviewContext). The actions
can also be part of the [Titanium.UI.iOS.PreviewActionGroup.actions](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.PreviewActionGroup#actions) property.

For an example, see [Titanium.UI.iOS.PreviewContext](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.PreviewContext).

See also:

* [iOS Developer Library: Adopting 3D Touch on iPhone](https://developer.apple.com/library/content/documentation/UserExperience/Conceptual/Adopting3DTouchOniPhone/3DTouchAPIs.html)

properties.name: title
properties.description: Provides a title to be shown when "peeking" a view referenced in the [Titanium.UI.iOS.PreviewContext](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.PreviewContext).

events.name: click
events.summary: Fired when the device detects a click against a preview action.
events.description:
This event provides different properties depending on the view the [Titanium.UI.iOS.PreviewContext](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.PreviewContext)
is assigned to. Every event has the `index` property to identify the clicked action. If the [Titanium.UI.iOS.PreviewContext](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.PreviewContext)
is assigned to a [Titanium.UI.ListView](api:Titanium.UI.ListView), the event provides the additional properties `itemIndex`, `sectionIndex` 
and `itemId` to identify the previewed row and section, respectively.

properties.name: index
properties.summary: The index of the clicked action.

properties.name: itemIndex
properties.summary:
The index of the clicked row, if the `previewContext` property of the [Titanium.UI.iOS.PreviewContext](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.PreviewContext)
is a [Titanium.UI.ListView](api:Titanium.UI.ListView).

properties.name: sectionIndex
properties.summary:
The index of the clicked section, if the `previewContext` property of the [Titanium.UI.iOS.PreviewContext](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.PreviewContext)
is a [Titanium.UI.ListView](api:Titanium.UI.ListView).

properties.name: itemId
properties.summary:
The item ID of cell, if the `previewContext` property of the [Titanium.UI.iOS.PreviewContext](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.PreviewContext)
is a [Titanium.UI.ListView](api:Titanium.UI.ListView).
